headline: Private consumption slightly up in September, INEGI estimates
summary: INEGI's timely indicator estimates Mexican private consumption rose 0.1% in September after a 0.5% gain in August. The same dynamic is expected to hold in October.
why: Private consumption is the largest component of Mexico's GDP, so its trend is a key gauge of domestic economic momentum.
original_headline: Consumo privado tiene leve avance en septiembre, estima el Inegi
